q4_flicker.measurement: motion-compensated (template-tracked shift), 80x50 px crop, color_1 vs taa_1, frame-to-frame RMS across the 16 consecutive pairs 46581-46597

q4_flicker.implied_effective_history_weight: ~0.75 (solving RMS_ratio = sqrt((1-keep)/(1+keep)) for keep), well below the far/thin ceilings (0.985/0.97) and not clearly higher than the plain 0.9 base history_weight
q4_flicker.caveat_inference: the tracking shift used for alignment is coarse (stride-4 template match, single global integer dx per frame), so this RMS mixes true flicker with residual misalignment/perspective-foreshortening signal; treat the absolute ratio as an order-of-magnitude estimate, not a clean flicker isolation

q5_mechanism.primary_candidate: sentinel-stabiliser's camera-relative gate assumes every unrouted sentinel-depth pixel sits at the far plane (pure-rotation, zero-parallax) for its correspondence: line_mask_ps.hlsl gateOpen() only adds camera translation parallax `if (validDepth(depth))` (src/temporal/line_mask_ps.hlsl:135-139); a sentinel pixel always takes depth=1 with NO translation term (line_mask_ps.hlsl:130 uses clip.z=1, no c8/c9 contribution), so its computed 'speed' is near zero under a pure-yaw pan even though the solar plant is a finite-distance object with real camera-translation parallax (t changes by several thousand units per frame in the camera_state log). This makes the camera gate open to full strength (b~0.7, confirmed) identically for the lattice struts and for genuinely infinite background, rather than closing where the far-plane assumption is wrong.
q5_mechanism.supporting_evidence: station pixels are 100% sentinel/unrouted (q3); refused specifically as no_zwrite (512) and overlay_node (576) for this object's shader across the window (q3); mask b is indistinguishable between station and sky (q3); no thin/fragmented gating is applied to the sentinel branch (line_mask_ps.hlsl:184-190 composes b = max(fragmented*a, S*cameraOpen) with no fragmentation requirement on the sentinel term)
file_line_candidates: src/temporal/line_mask_ps.hlsl:70-74 (sentinel-stabiliser comment: any unrouted sentinel pixel gets the boost, not just lattice pixels)
src/temporal/line_mask_ps.hlsl:126-140 (gateOpen: camera translation only applied on valid depth, never on sentinel depth)
src/temporal/line_mask_ps.hlsl:184-190 (composition: sentinel term is a plain max(), unconditioned on 'fragmented')

src/temporal/resolve.hlsl:453-457 (old = lerp(clipped, old, a) + (b-a)*(boxed-clipped): with a=0, b=0.7, the resolve trusts the 7x7 box bound at full configured strength wherever the sentinel bit fired)
src/renderer/temporal_pass.cpp:409,430 (thin_constants: thinGate.z/w reuse far_speed_lo/hi as the camera-gate speed thresholds; not separately tuned for the sentinel case)
q5_mechanism.confidence: inference: the code-path reasoning is direct from the shader source and matches the measured uniform b~0.7 and 100% sentinel/unrouted classification; the causal link from 'wrong zero-parallax assumption' to the specific residual visible flicker is not independently proven by a controlled A/B capture (sentinel-stabiliser off vs on) in this triage, which would be the clean next diagnostic.

clip_box_bind_frequency.method: reconstructed the resolve's 7x7 same-size min/max box from hdr_1 (current frame) and bilinear-shifted the PREVIOUS frame's taa_1 by the tracked sub-pixel dx to approximate the reprojected 'old' history sample (horizontal shift only, in raw hdr/taa linear units -- resolve.hlsl's weigh()/unweigh() tonemap curve is not reproduced, so this is a same-space approximation, not an exact replica of the shader's clip test)
clip_box_bind_frequency.interpretation: the fraction of the station crop where the reprojected history falls outside the local 7x7 current-frame min/max (i.e. where the box-clip would actively override 'old') tracks the pan speed almost linearly (r=0.956): near 0 speed it is ~1-3%, at 30-40 px/frame it is ~24-42% of the crop. This is a direct, code-grounded explanation of why suppression degrades specifically during the pan and not at rest.
